stem:
The random variable $X$ has probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} kx^{-1} & 2 \leqslant x \leqslant 6, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Show that $\text{E}(X) = 3.64$, correct to 3 significant figures.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Given that the median of $X$ is $m$, find $\text{P}(m < X < \text{E}(X))$.
